summary_1line: Hanuman stealthily explores the vast, guarded palace complex of Ravana in Lanka, marveling at its wealth and searching the mansions of powerful demon lords.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman crouches on the golden rooftop of Ravana’s glittering palace, gazing over Lanka’s courtyards filled with elephants, chariots, and armed demons.
Moonlit palace halls shine with gold and silver while jeweled women move within, their ornaments tinkling as Hanuman slips unseen through the shadows.
Outside Ravana’s chamber, fierce demon women with spears and maces stand guard as Hanuman watches silently from a high archway.
